careerFaqs: Is it truly work from home?
Yes. All roles marked “Work From Home” are 100% remote. You never need to visit an office. A few roles marked “Hybrid” include optional office days in Gurugram.
It depends on the role. Tele-calling roles offer 4, 6 or 8-hour shifts between 8 AM and 10 PM. Marketing roles generally work 10 AM – 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday.
Fixed salary is paid by bank transfer on the 5th of every month. Incentives for eligible roles are paid weekly. You receive a salary slip every month.
Yes — and it's paid. Every new team member gets structured online training before starting live work, plus ongoing coaching.
Not for many roles. Tele-caller, lead generation and intern roles welcome freshers. Specialist roles like SEO and Meta Ads need 1–3 years of experience.
Do I have to pay anything to join?

Never. ScaleNest Digital does not charge any fee for applications, training, registration, ID cards or equipment. If anyone asks you to pay, it's a scam — please report it to careers@scalenestdigital.com.

General: Our head office is at 4th Floor, Tower B, Unitech Cyber Park, Sector 39, Gurugram, Haryana. Most of our team works remotely across India.
Which businesses do you work with?
Mostly small and mid-sized Indian businesses in real estate, education, healthcare, finance, D2C e-commerce, hospitality and professional services.
Do you work with clients outside Gurugram?
Yes. We serve clients across India and a growing number in the UAE, UK and USA.
Book a free consultation. We'll review your current marketing and send a recommendation within 48 hours — no obligation.
Services: Can I hire you for just one service?
Absolutely. Many clients start with a single service like SEO or Meta Ads and add more later.

Who owns the ad accounts and website?
You do. Ad accounts, analytics, domains and websites are always set up in your name.
Do you offer white-label services for agencies?
Yes. We offer white-label SEO, web development and tele-calling to other agencies.
Pricing: Some services have a one-time onboarding fee, which is shown clearly on our pricing page. There are no hidden charges.
Is GST included in your prices?
Prices are exclusive of 18% GST, which is added to invoices.

Yes. Contact us and we'll build a plan around your goals and budget.

Yes. Over 80% of our team works from home across 18 Indian states.
